datasets.name: JMuBEN
datasets.citation: Jepkoech et al. (2021). JMuBEN. Mendeley Data V1. doi:10.17632/t2r6rszp5c.1
datasets.preprocessing_notes: Kenyan Arabica leaves. Cropped, squared, rotated/flipped source images. Local clean PNGs; exact deduplication; D4 pixel grouping; reviewed pHash candidates. size_mb is retained clean files only.
datasets.what_it_does_not_cover: No demonstrated Indian field accuracy; not an agronomic treatment source.

datasets.name: JMuBEN2
datasets.citation: Jepkoech et al. (2021). JMuBEN2. Mendeley Data V1. doi:10.17632/tgv3zb82nd.1
datasets.preprocessing_notes: Healthy and Miner from Kenyan Arabica. Cropped, squared and augmented source images. Local clean PNGs; grouping before splitting. size_mb is retained clean files only.
datasets.what_it_does_not_cover: Not evidence for other pests, coffee species, or uncropped phone photos.

datasets.name: PlantDoc
datasets.citation: PlantDoc; local PlantDoc-Dataset-master checkout. Verify license, exact revision and paper citation before distribution.
datasets.preprocessing_notes: Only source train/test class trees; both retained as OOD test only. Non-coffee labels map to unknown. Documentation illustrations excluded.
datasets.what_it_does_not_cover: Not coffee training or validation data. Unknown/rejection evaluation only.

datasets.name: own_photos
datasets.citation: Project-owned independently labelled phone-photo collection; populate actual collection metadata when imported.
datasets.preprocessing_notes: Metadata-free, labelled real-world photos; repeated views grouped using capture leaf IDs. Never train or tune on this set.
datasets.what_it_does_not_cover: A 20-30 leaf convenience pilot does not establish population-wide diagnostic accuracy.

datasets.name: common_voice_hi
datasets.version: 27.0-2026-09-11 (local directory label; verify against release manifest)
datasets.citation: Mozilla Common Voice Hindi; local directory cv-corpus-27.0-2026-09-11-hi. Release citation and license require manifest verification.
datasets.preprocessing_notes: Speech recognition only. Not read or imported by the image workflow.
datasets.what_it_does_not_cover: Not synthesized voice, farmer-facing advice recordings, or leaf disease evidence.
